markets.rules_secondary:
The following market refers to Daniel Jones in the Indianapolis vs Minnesota Pro Football game originally scheduled for Oct 25, 2026. If Daniel Jones is active but never takes a snap, the market settles to the fair market price before game start. Once Daniel Jones takes at least one snap, even if nullified by penalty, the market settles based on passing yards recorded.
